cohort: 108 postpartum patients who had undergone operative vaginal delivery (63 vacuum-assisted, 45 forceps-assisted) and attended a postpartum assessment service.
finding: There was no significant difference in the prevalence of new-onset incontinence symptoms, frequency and amount of urine leakage, or mean pelvic floor muscle strength scores between vacuum-assisted and forceps-assisted deliveries.
mod_finding: Type of operative vaginal delivery was not associated with significant differences in urinary incontinence and pelvic floor muscle strength outcomes.
